name: Reorganisation Instruction SD 15
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action reorganisation instruction details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique number assigned by the depository. Transaction identification will be either the DTC instruction reference number for reorganisation instructions (VOI) or the DAM reference number for custody/reorganisation deposits.

TransactionSequence.name: Transaction Sequence
TransactionSequence.definition: Enable input of multiple voluntary instructions for rights or voluntary puts events via a single instruction message through using transaction sequence number.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason for which an inbound instruction message or a cancellation instruction message is pending or rejected.

SecuritiesQuantityDetails.name: Securities Quantity Details
SecuritiesQuantityDetails.definition: Provides further information about securities quantity linked to a corporate action option.

CustomerReferenceIdentification.name: Customer Reference Identification
CustomerReferenceIdentification.definition: Customer identification entered by the client upon instruction submission.

AcknowledgementDetails.name: Acknowledgement Details
AcknowledgementDetails.definition: Acknowledgement information relative to corporate action reorganisation instructions.

ContactPerson.name: Contact Person
ContactPerson.definition: Party contact information for the given instruction; required for a voluntary offer instruction transaction (VOIT), protect transaction (PROT) and protect on behalf of another participant transaction (PROP); not required for cover protect instructions like a cover protect transaction (COVR), cover protect directly to agent transaction (COVA) and cover protect on behalf of another participant transaction (COVP).

WarrantSubscriptionChargeAmount.name: Warrant Subscription Charge Amount
WarrantSubscriptionChargeAmount.definition: Warrant subscription amount entered by client when instructing on a warrant exercise instruction.

Certificate.name: Certificate
Certificate.definition: Certificate information for a given instruction.

UserReferenceNumber.name: User Reference Number
UserReferenceNumber.definition: Unique identification of the transaction used by the transmitting party.

DeceasedBeneficialOwnerDetails.name: Deceased Beneficial Owner Details
DeceasedBeneficialOwnerDetails.definition: Beneficial owner information related to CD early redemption instructions.

TransactionRecordNumber.name: Transaction Record Number
TransactionRecordNumber.definition: Transaction record number for ATAM or ART system which may be causing pending status. Corresponds to ATP RBN number.

ShareholderNumber.name: Shareholder Number
ShareholderNumber.definition: Reference number assigned to identify an investor or a shareholder with the issuer or the registration provider (for instance allocation code).
